escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Fixed header/footer clipping discards genuine financial anchors while allowing the remaining rows through.

literal_case.observed: Complete reconciled rows are retained; overlapping/incomplete financial anchors block, contact numbers are ignored.

prevention_change.description: Remove the fixed lower cutoff and reject suspicious financial anchors beyond structural footer; existing parser tests cover lower boundary and near-header cases.

detection_change.description: Run all five near-header/footer/lower-boundary controls and the three old-behavior mutations.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A synthetic 38-row fixture or a different real 42-row statement is substituted for the required original binary.

literal_case.expected: The exact 61469-byte original has 3 pages and 38 matching rows; truncated original is rejected.
literal_case.observed: The exact 61469-byte original has 3 pages and 38 matching rows; truncated original is rejected.

prevention_change.description: Use only the original binary directly uploaded by the user, verify its digest and compare all 38 rows privately against a second layout-text reconstruction.

detection_change.description: Run the directly uploaded original binary, compare its private SHA256 and every original row, then truncate that same binary as a negative control.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A foreign issue or branch certificate is reused merely because its files exist in the target branch.

literal_case.observed: Foreign-target packages are rejected and this PR continues to target develop at the trusted base.

prevention_change.description: Build a fresh issue-745 certificate with exact material identity and its own closure. Never reuse the inherited issue-742 certificate or claim independent approval.

detection_change.description: Run the official target-binding classifier regressions for foreign target and exact current target; verify trusted base ancestry and fresh PR metadata.

prevention_change.description: Include semantic-effect with every existing declared surface and control, preserving historical controls and private evidence hashes.

detection_change.description: Execute official auditor saturation and full delivery preflight in addition to the certificate builder; missing and deactivated family controls reject.
